description: Rain's loud sibling, per docs/16: one to three hours, wets like rain, washes scent harder and the noise field too, refuses outdoor work, and lightning lands every ten minutes to two hours as a noise nobody made (60: louder than half a shout, quieter than any gun -- a strike that out-shouts a rifle summons the district, which is the opposite of masking; and not 180, 120 or 4, which sfx.gd dispatches one-shots by). No windMul: the first cut doubled the climate's wind and the harness read it as the difference between a colony and none on seed 20260805 (docs/23's record). First cuts for the owner. Read by SimWeather only.
